listen_addrs.description: List of IP:port bindings for the DNS server to listen on (e.g., ['0.0.0.0,53', '192.0.2.1,53']).

items.description: Each element is a list with exactly two items: IP address and port (both strings).
A single component: IP address or port.

max_udp_size.description: Maximum UDP packet size in bytes for DNS responses. RFC 8020 recommends ≥ 4096 for EDNS0.

tcp_fallback.description: If enabled, accept TCP connections as fallback when UDP responses exceed the client-suggested size.

workers.description: Number of worker threads to spawn. Set to number of CPU cores for best performance.

geo_sources.description: List of geographic database file paths (e.g., MaxMind MMDB files) used for geolocation lookups.

zones.description: List of DNS zones served by this server.

file.description: Path to the zone data file (e.g., '/etc/gdnsd/zones/example.com'). Optional if geodata is used.

options.description: List of zone-level options, each as a key-value pair (e.g., ['soa_ttl: 86400', 'refresh: 10800']).

geodatas.description: List of geolocation rules for this zone. Each list item is a set of IP/geolocation mappings.

items.description: A set of IP-to-location rules for geographically-aware responses.

ip.description: IPv4 address (e.g., '192.0.2.0'). Either ip, net, or host must be present.

location.description: Geographic location code (e.g., 'US', 'EU', 'ASIA' — must match entries in geo_sources).
